title: Build protected Admin participant and invitation UI
verify: An own-center Admin can open the protected participant page, submit a permitted teacher/student/parent role, and receive an invitation URL/status produced by the existing Center & Scheduling participant boundary.
Unauthenticated, non-Admin, and cross-center page/action requests are rejected server-side before account, membership, or invitation state changes; UI visibility is not used as proof.
The returned invitation reaches the TASK-020 browser acceptance path and account/membership/invitation state is committed or unchanged as one outcome.

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned Admin probe, live disposable SSR/form/API smoke, and the required check/build/full-test/diff gates passed; the current functional report records VERDICT: PASS.

FT-001-AC-008 passed for own-center Admin success, unauthenticated/non-Admin/wrong-center denial before mutation, server-generated identifiers, TASK-020 invitation handoff, and account+membership+invitation atomicity.
Independent T3 adversarial review passed stale/mismatched actor authority, non-Admin, wrong-center, alternate-write, direct-persistence, secret-leakage, dev-bypass, and route-export checks.
The current semantic artifact records SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass; task identity/status, dependency, lifecycle, and retry budget remain unchanged.

evidence_required: FT-001-AC-008 RED: the Admin page/action is reachable without an Admin own-center session, trusts a submitted center/role, writes directly, or leaves partial account/membership/invitation state; GREEN: own-center Admin success calls the existing authorized participant boundary, all negative requests are rejected before mutation, and the state snapshot is atomic; artifact: .tasks/TASK-021-T3-FT-001-W9/ and .protocols/TASK-021-T3-FT-001-W9/verification.md.

FT-001-AC-008 integration RED: a successful form does not return a usable one-time invitation or the returned link cannot enter the accepted provider flow; GREEN: the Admin receives a safe invitation URL/status and the link completes through TASK-020's documented invite path without role/center selection; artifact: .tasks/TASK-021-T3-FT-001-W9/ and .protocols/TASK-021-T3-FT-001-W9/verification.md.
purpose: Expose the smallest real protected Admin UI/API action for center-created participant accounts and one-time invitations.
success_outcome: The server-protected Admin page creates a center-bounded participant through the existing owner boundary, returns a usable one-time invitation, and denies every unauthorized or cross-center attempt without mutation.
anti_goals: Do not write Identity & Access or membership tables from routes, actions, or components.
Do not duplicate the TASK-015 authorization/atomicity command or expose createAccount/issueInvitation bypasses.
Do not make UI hiding the only authorization check or add unrelated center/scheduling screens.

stop_conditions: Stop if the Admin flow requires direct database access, a new ownership edge, or changing the accepted Center & Scheduling/Identity & Access boundaries.

constraints: Center & Scheduling remains the membership owner and the existing createParticipant public path is the only provisioning call from the Admin transport.
The target center is server-resolved and own-center Admin authorization is repeated in the form action.
The page/form test uses isolated disposable persistence and records state-before/state-after plus safe cleanup.
invariants: Only an authenticated own-center Admin can perform the participant provisioning action.
A participant account, its center membership, and its invitation are committed together or not at all.
The invitation link is one-time, expiring, and enters only the accepted provider-binding path.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-008: running SvelteKit page/form or HTTP action smoke for own-center Admin success, non-Admin/unauthenticated/cross-center denial, server-generated identifiers, and state-before/state-after comparison.
